idea: Prior authorization automation with AI for health insurers

answers.audience: Health plan medical directors and VP of Clinical Operations
answers.goal: Feasibility study for replacing manual PA review with AI-assisted decisioning
answers.constraints: Must comply with CMS interoperability rules and state PA timeliness mandates
answers.focus_areas: Accuracy vs human review, liability, vendor landscape, integration with utilization management systems

idea: Semantic layer for agentic AI in healthcare payer operations

answers.audience: Chief Data Officers and enterprise architects at regional health plans
answers.goal: Architecture design for enabling LLM agents to query claims, eligibility, and clinical data safely
answers.constraints: HIPAA compliance, existing EDW on Snowflake, heterogeneous source systems (FACETS, QNXT)
answers.focus_areas: Semantic layer vendors (AtScale, Cube, dbt Semantic Layer), governance, query federation, hallucination mitigation

idea: GraphRAG for insurance claims processing and fraud detection

answers.audience: Special Investigations Unit directors and data science leads at health plans
answers.goal: Evaluate whether graph-augmented retrieval materially improves fraud ring detection over vector-only RAG
answers.constraints: Must explain decisions to regulators; existing Neo4j investment
answers.focus_areas: GraphRAG vs standard RAG accuracy benchmarks, provider network analysis, claim linkage, real-world deployments

idea: Utilization management modernization with AI for health plans

answers.audience: VP of Utilization Management and CMO at a regional Blue plan
answers.goal: Roadmap for AI-augmented UM that reduces administrative burden while maintaining quality outcomes
answers.constraints: URAC accreditation requirements, physician advisor shortage, concurrent review volumes
answers.focus_areas: Clinical criteria engines (InterQual, MCG), AI-assisted peer-to-peer, predictive inappropriate-utilization scoring

idea: AI-powered fraud, waste and abuse detection for medical claims at scale

answers.audience: SIU leaders and compliance officers at national health insurers
answers.goal: Benchmark current AI FWA capabilities and identify gaps versus best-in-class
answers.constraints: Must not produce disparate impact across provider demographics; OIG exclusion list integration required
answers.focus_areas: Anomaly detection models, network analysis, false positive rates, CMS FWA requirements, vendor comparison (Cotiviti, Optum, Verscend)

idea: Member 360 data platform for health plans enabling personalized care management

answers.audience: Chief Data Officer and VP Care Management at a regional health plan (2M members)
answers.goal: Architecture and vendor assessment for unified member data platform
answers.constraints: HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2 for SUD data, interoperability with 30+ data sources
answers.focus_areas: Real-time eligibility, SDoH integration, care gap identification, cloud data platform options (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure)

idea: AI for clinical documentation review in prior authorization workflows

answers.audience: Medical Directors and Clinical Operations leaders at health plans
answers.goal: Assess NLP/LLM capability for auto-extracting clinical criteria from submitted records to accelerate PA decisions
answers.constraints: FDA SaMD classification risk, physician liability, state prompt-pay laws
answers.focus_areas: Accuracy on unstructured clinical notes, ICD-10/CPT extraction, integration with PA platforms (Cohere Health, Olive, Availity)

idea: Real-time eligibility and benefits verification with AI for providers

answers.audience: Revenue cycle directors at large hospital systems and payer IT leaders
answers.goal: Reduce claim denials due to eligibility errors through predictive and real-time verification
answers.constraints: X12 270/271 transaction standards, CAQH CORE rules, Epic integration requirement
answers.focus_areas: Real-time API vs batch, error prediction models, denial root cause analytics, clearinghouse vendors

idea: AI-driven appeals and grievances automation for health insurers

answers.audience: VP Member Experience and Compliance Officers at managed care organizations
answers.goal: Reduce appeal cycle time and administrative cost while improving first-level resolution rates
answers.constraints: CMS and state regulatory deadlines (72-hour expedited), NCQA standards, member adverse event risk
answers.focus_areas: NLP for appeal classification, auto-routing, decision support, CMS audit readiness, ACA QHP requirements

answers.audience: CFOs and finance operations managers at small businesses (10-200 employees)
answers.goal: Feasibility and vendor comparison for replacing manual AP with AI automation
answers.constraints: QuickBooks/Xero integration required, under $500/month budget, minimal IT overhead
answers.focus_areas: OCR accuracy, ERP integration, pricing models, leading vendors (Bill.com, Stampli, Rossum)

idea: Autonomous code review AI platform for software engineering teams

answers.audience: VPs Engineering and platform leads at mid-size SaaS companies
answers.goal: Evaluate AI code review tools against human review quality and developer velocity impact
answers.constraints: Must support GitHub and GitLab, security scanning, SOC 2 compliant hosting
answers.focus_areas: Bug detection rates, false positive rates, PR cycle time, vendor comparison (CodeRabbit, Qodo, GitHub Copilot)

idea: Supply chain risk intelligence platform with AI for manufacturing companies

answers.audience: Chief Supply Chain Officers and procurement VPs at Fortune 500 manufacturers
answers.goal: Identify best-of-breed AI platforms for proactive supplier risk monitoring and disruption prediction
answers.constraints: Integration with SAP Ariba and Oracle SCM, ESG reporting requirements, 50,000+ supplier base
answers.focus_areas: Geopolitical risk signals, financial health scoring, sub-tier visibility, leading vendors (Resilinc, Everstream, Riskmethods)
